before.styles: Instrumental hardcore punk rock, fixed 175 BPM in C# Minor, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. Two razor-edged guitars trade short attacks on C#5 -> F#5 -> E5 -> G#5; one climbs in octaves while the other stays low and rhythmic. Open hats, kick and a flam-accented snare hammer the full-speed pulse. Their crossing phrases combine into one forceful hook before splitting again. Aim for about 3:15.
before.exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
